reviews.text: Our cat spent 10 days at the cattery and everything went very well. We received regular updates and photos, which is really reassuring when you entrust your pet to someone. Upon his return, he was in great shape and seemed to have enjoyed his stay. Thank you for your warm welcome and attentiveness; we will definitely return!
Thank you so much for this stay. My cats were delighted with your welcome. Thank you for your availability and prompt service.

The most pleasant and beautiful cat boarding facility in Lyon 😊 This is the second time I've left my little cat there. The place is safe, pleasant, and secure, and the care and attention given to the cats is excellent and very kind. I receive photos of my cat on vacation, feeling more and more at ease in this little feline paradise 🐱 We can enjoy a peaceful holiday while thinking of them thanks to the photos!

I entrusted Yana to a sitter for the first time and I am absolutely delighted with the experience. She was wonderfully welcomed and I immediately felt she was in very good hands. As a veterinary assistant student, it was important for me to find a place where my cat would be cared for in impeccable hygienic conditions and where animal welfare is respected! And bingo, at ZoeBonbon, all the conditions are met 🤩
The conditions there are excellent: the spaces are clean and cleaned with appropriate products, and the areas are cat-friendly and designed with their well-being in mind. A true cat paradise! The owners are attentive, professional, and truly take the time to care for each animal gently.
I found Yana relaxed and in great shape, which shows how well she was looked after. It's very reassuring to be able to leave knowing that your companion is in such a caring and reliable place. A huge thank you for your work and your love of animals. Yana will definitely be back in July to spend her holidays with her friends 🐈🐾
I highly recommend it!!!!

We entrusted our cats to Zoébonbon for over two weeks and we are delighted with the experience.
Jacqueline and her husband took the utmost care of our feline friends. They were extremely available, attentive, and kept us updated very regularly, which allowed us to leave with complete peace of mind.
Our cats were pampered just like at home… and even got their favorite dish: shrimp! 🦐 A huge thank you for your kindness and care. We will entrust Léon and Cricky to you again without hesitation. :)

I highly recommend them! My cat Flocon is super sweet but very shy, and at Zoebonbon the owners took excellent care of him. He even went out for a little walk with the other cats. Plus, I received updates throughout his stay, which was completely reassuring. They have a great space and they are very attentive to the cats they look after—truly a gem of a cat daycare in Lyon ☺️

Always happy to leave Minette at Zoebonbon. The cats always have company during the day, lots of cuddles, lots of good care, a fantastic cattery! Minette always falls back into her routine very quickly when she arrives and doesn't want to leave!! 😁 😅 😂 That's a very, very good sign, of course! You can see that she's very happy to be there, and you can tell every time she comes back. Thank you, Mr. and Mrs. Biancal. 👍

Hello, dear ZoeBombom family members,

My sincerest THANK YOU.

What more can I say about the Zoe family? Today, a month after returning from my vacation in Brazil, I'm still feeling the effects of the exceptional care my Rio received during the 40 days he spent with you.

The most memorable moment for me, as the owner of a jealous but very affectionate cat, was receiving the first two photos accompanied by the message:

"Here's Valeria, relax! Rio has already come out of hiding and is making friends..."
WOW — my heart instantly melted.

ZoeBombom knows how to reassure cat owners because you give so much love to the animals. The multitude of things you provide to stimulate and entertain them allows them to feel safe and surrounded by love. And the impeccable cleanliness of the premises guarantees the health and well-being of the cats.

I highly recommend ZoeBombom.

What a relief to entrust my cat to the managers of Zoébonbon! They take great care of our felines and provide regular updates. A wonderful welcome, kindness, and a large, well-maintained play area. This is a cattery with top-notch quality!

We entrusted our cat to Zoébonbon for two weeks while we were on vacation. Seth isn't usually comfortable in catteries, and we were surprised to see how much fun he had! He made lots of friends and wasn't at all upset when we came home. We're amazed by how well he adapted and thrived; a huge thank you to Jacqueline for taking such good care of our cat! We'll definitely go back.

I left my kitten at Zoebonbon for the first time and I have absolutely no regrets. I received updates very regularly and photos every day. The owners seem just as loving towards our pets as we are, and they took the time to explain how the cat daycare worked, how the cats adapted… so I had no worries at all going on vacation. I picked up my cat in perfect health and very happy with his short stay. I will definitely not hesitate to return and I highly recommend this cat daycare. Thank you again for taking such great care of my cat!

Zoébonbon is an excellent boarding facility; I highly recommend it for your furry friends. Uno is always welcomed with great care and affection.

Being very attentive to my little cat's environment and well-being, I always leave him with a light heart, and he returns home to his normal life as if I had left him the day before.

A big thank you to Zoébonbon!

Carole, Lyon 6th arrondissement

I 100% recommend this cat paradise! It's the first time I've left my cat at this cattery, and certainly not the last! My shy Yoda was pampered for two weeks, and I received daily updates. He was showered with cuddles and thoroughly enjoyed this wonderful establishment. A thousand thanks again to the owners, who do everything they can to make our furry friends' stay as pleasant as possible!

Our cat Zébulon has been spending his holidays at Zoébonbon for the past five years. We highly recommend this cattery! Jacqueline and her husband take excellent care of the cats entrusted to them, looking after them conscientiously and with kindness. They are attentive to every detail and take into account the specific needs of each guest.

Furthermore, the place is perfectly maintained and very cozy. Thank you for everything, and see you soon!

Zoé Bonbon's cat daycare is a true paradise for cats! From our very first visit, I was struck by the owners' genuine love for animals. Their kindness, compassion, and professionalism are simply exceptional. My cat, Othello, is treated like royalty there, pampered, cuddled, and surrounded by tender attention.

The facilities are impeccable: clean, safe, enriching, and designed to stimulate and soothe our whiskered companions. You can tell that everything has been created with passion and a deep respect for feline well-being.

But what makes this daycare truly unique are the owners. Their gentleness and dedication are rare and deeply touching. They don't just look after the cats, they love them. And that makes all the difference.

I always leave Othello in their care with complete peace of mind. A gem of a place, which I highly recommend!

Caramel has been a very regular guest for the past 5 or 6 years. I leave him there for 8 to 10 days practically every school holiday.

It's an exceptional cattery where the cats are happy. Jacqueline and Jean-Paul's passion for cats is palpable. Caramel is pampered, cuddled, and smells divine when we pick him up. A huge thank you!
Roxane M
Thank you so much for your comment! Okami has been coming to our house since she was a kitten and we're always happy to see her again!!
Thank you so much for your availability and attention. We always go on holiday with peace of mind, knowing that our little Yuki is in good hands.

We regularly entrust our cat to Zoé Bonbon. At 20 years old, she needs to take several medications every day, and we are completely at ease about that.
The couple who run the cattery spend a lot of time with their guests, carefully attending to each one's needs. They clearly feel very comfortable there.
The space is very clean, calm, and well-organized. We highly recommend it.

Another excellent stay for our cat Cookie, who came back more affectionate than ever. A top-quality boarding facility where cats are happy and serene. Thank you for your excellent care. I highly recommend it!
Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a review! Hollow really feels at home at Zoebonbon! And he loves seeing his friends every time!
Everything was perfect. Another stay planned!

You can go there with your eyes closed. Leave with complete peace of mind. The Zoébonbon staff are simply exceptional; cats will be happier there than at home. As for humans, they are welcomed in the best possible way. Zoébonbon is THE solution.
A true paradise for my little Rocky.
Thank you and well done!
I regularly leave my cat with Jacqueline and Jean-Paul. I'm delighted. My cat feels very comfortable there. Very clean. Lots of toys and a fantastic setup! I highly recommend them. Thank you so much.

I left my 6-month-old cat, Loup, for 6 days for his first stay at a cattery. Communication with the manager was smooth and efficient. The initial meeting allowed Loup to discover a new place and get acquainted with his future companions. The food, care, and layout of the cattery are very well-suited. The large living area is full of toys. During his stay, I received daily updates about my cat, along with photos (also available on Instagram). When I picked him up, Loup seemed very happy, calm, and relaxed. I highly recommend this cattery. Thank you to Jacqueline and Jean-Paul!
The place is very well maintained and secure. The owners are very friendly and welcoming, a very good experience, thank you again to them for Fripouille.
